description_en: Re-runs a task flow instance by calling the ReRunTaskFlowInstance operation
description_zh: 调用ReRunTaskFlowInstance接口，重跑任务流实例
name: ReRunTaskFlowInstance

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and view the tenant ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow execution record. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task flow version number. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465989.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流版本号，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465989.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_version
